node-pty 1.1.0 bundles Microsoft ConPTY 1.23.251008001 in third_party/conpty/.
Yami uses the bundled Windows x64 ConPTY DLL and OpenConsole executable.
Microsoft Terminal/ConPTY source license: MIT, Microsoft Corporation.
License source inspected 2026-10-18:
https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/blob/main/LICENSE
The required Microsoft notice is preserved in ConPTY-LICENSE.txt.
node-pty's own LICENSE and deps/winpty/LICENSE are collected separately.
